figs.name: negative-pressure-in-pipelines-high-point-diagram
figs.alt: negative pressure in pipelines at a high point above the hydraulic grade line with vacuum breaker
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing a pipeline high point above the hydraulic grade line, where pressure falls below atmospheric and an air valve admits air to protect the pipe.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Negative pressure at a pipeline high point with a vacuum breaker valve</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#164e63" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Where Negative Pressure Forms in a Pipeline</text>
<polyline points="60,360 200,330 360,150 420,140 560,300 740,380" fill="none" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="16"/>
<polyline points="60,360 200,330 360,150 420,140 560,300 740,380" fill="none" stroke="#bfdbfe" stroke-width="10"/>
<circle cx="60" cy="360" r="26" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#164e63" stroke-width="3"/>
<text x="60" y="367" font-size="19" fill="#164e63" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">P</text>
<text x="60" y="410" font-size="17" fill="#164e63" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Pump</text>
<polyline points="60,230 300,236 420,250 740,300" fill="none" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="8 6"/>
<text x="40" y="212" font-size="17" fill="#0e7490" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Hydraulic grade line</text>
<rect x="330" y="126" width="120" height="50" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/>
<text x="482" y="172" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">pipe above the grade line:</text>
<text x="482" y="194" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">below atmospheric</text>
<line x1="395" y1="140" x2="395" y2="96" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="6"/>
<rect x="372" y="70" width="46" height="28" rx="5" fill="#16a34a"/>
<line x1="450" y1="62" x2="405" y2="80" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="460" y="66" font-size="17" fill="#16a34a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Vacuum breaker or air valve</text>
<text x="460" y="90" font-size="17" fill="#16a34a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">lets air in to break the vacuum</text>
<line x1="740" y1="380" x2="770" y2="392" stroke="#164e63" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="700" y="420" font-size="17" fill="#164e63" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">draining or outflow</text>
<circle cx="200" cy="480" r="36" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="6"/>
<line x1="286.0" y1="480.0" x2="246.0" y2="480.0" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="260.81118318204307" y1="529.4974746830583" x2="232.5269119345812" y2="509.698484809835" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="200.0" y1="550.0" x2="200.0" y2="522.0" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="139.18881681795693" y1="529.4974746830583" x2="167.4730880654188" y2="509.698484809835" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="114.0" y1="480.0" x2="154.0" y2="480.0" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="139.1888168179569" y1="430.50252531694167" x2="167.4730880654188" y2="450.301515190165" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="199.99999999999997" y1="410.0" x2="200.0" y2="438.0" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="260.81118318204307" y1="430.50252531694167" x2="232.52691193458116" y2="450.301515190165" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="200" y="486" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">low P</text>
<text x="300" y="470" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Outside pressure pushes inward:</text>
<text x="300" y="496" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">thin wall, plastic or ageing pipes can buckle,</text>
<text x="300" y="520" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">and joints can draw in air or contaminants</text>
</svg>

figs.name: negative-pressure-in-pipelines-cause-fix-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart matching negative pressure causes in pipelines to fixes like air valves and slow closure
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog matching each vacuum cause in the article, from pump suction and draining to transients, cooling and fan inlets, with the prevention step.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart for finding the cause of negative pressure and the matching fix</title>
<rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#164e63" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Vacuum Found? Match the Cause to the Fix</text>
<polygon points="240,68.0 405.0,110 240,152.0 75.0,110" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="240" y="115.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">At pump suction?</text>
<line x1="405" y1="110" x2="450" y2="110" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="427" y="98" font-size="17" fill="#164e63" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="450" y="74" width="330" height="72" rx="10" fill="#ecfeff" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="615.0" y="104.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Clean strainer, open valve,</text>
<text x="615.0" y="127.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">check pump not oversized</text>
<line x1="240" y1="152" x2="240" y2="168" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="258" y="164" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="240,168.0 405.0,210 240,252.0 75.0,210" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="240" y="205.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">At a high point</text>
<text x="240" y="226.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">while draining?</text>
<line x1="405" y1="210" x2="450" y2="210" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="427" y="198" font-size="17" fill="#164e63" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="450" y="174" width="330" height="72" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="615.0" y="204.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Service or fit air valve</text>
<text x="615.0" y="227.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">at the high point</text>
<line x1="240" y1="252" x2="240" y2="268" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="258" y="264" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="240,268.0 405.0,310 240,352.0 75.0,310" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="240" y="305.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">After a pump trip or</text>
<text x="240" y="326.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">fast valve closure?</text>
<line x1="405" y1="310" x2="450" y2="310" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="427" y="298" font-size="17" fill="#164e63" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="450" y="274" width="330" height="72" rx="10" fill="#ecfeff" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="615.0" y="304.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Slow starts and stops,</text>
<text x="615.0" y="327.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">control transients</text>
<line x1="240" y1="352" x2="240" y2="368" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="258" y="364" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="240,368.0 405.0,410 240,452.0 75.0,410" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="240" y="405.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Hot liquid cooling</text>
<text x="240" y="426.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">in an isolated line?</text>
<line x1="405" y1="410" x2="450" y2="410" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="427" y="398" font-size="17" fill="#164e63" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="450" y="374" width="330" height="72" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="615.0" y="404.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Add vacuum relief or</text>
<text x="615.0" y="427.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">a makeup connection</text>
<line x1="240" y1="452" x2="240" y2="468" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="258" y="464" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="240,468.0 405.0,510 240,552.0 75.0,510" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="240" y="505.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">At a fan inlet</text>
<text x="240" y="526.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">in a duct?</text>
<line x1="405" y1="510" x2="450" y2="510" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="427" y="498" font-size="17" fill="#164e63" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="450" y="474" width="330" height="72" rx="10" fill="#ecfeff" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="615.0" y="504.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Clear louvers and filters,</text>
<text x="615.0" y="527.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">match fan to intake</text>
<text x="400" y="586" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Buried and subsea lines carry extra outside load, so check them first</text>
</svg>

figs.name: negative-pressure-in-pipelines-core-principle-infographic
figs.alt: negative pressure in pipelines causes for liquid, gas and all systems with the core principle
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the article core principle, more fluid leaving than entering, with the causes listed for liquid lines, gas lines and all pipeline systems.
figs.after_h2: The core principle (the “one line” you should remember)
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 540" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Core principle of negative pressure: outflow exceeds inflow and the pipe cannot breathe</title>
<rect width="800" height="540" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#164e63" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">The One Line to Remember</text>

<text x="400" y="156" font-size="20" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">pressure falls</text>

<rect x="30" y="286" width="236" height="220" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2"/>
<rect x="30" y="286" width="236" height="48" rx="14" fill="#0e7490"/>
